verses.text: Therefore, since we too have so great a cloud of witnesses surrounding us, let us lay aside every weight and the sin that readily entangles us, and run with endurance the race set before us,
verses.display_text: Therefore, since we too have so great a cloud of witnesses surrounding us, let us lay aside every weight and the sin that readily entangles us, and run with endurance the race set before us,

verses.text: looking away to Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith. For the joy set before Him He endured a cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.display_text: looking away to Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith. For the joy set before Him He endured a cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

verses.text: For consider the One who has endured such opposition from sinners against Himself, so that you may not grow weary, fainting in your souls.
verses.display_text: For consider the One who has endured such opposition from sinners against Himself, so that you may not grow weary, fainting in your souls.

verses.text: You have not yet resisted to the point of blood in your struggle against sin,
verses.display_text: You have not yet resisted to the point of blood in your struggle against sin,

verses.text: and you have forgotten the encouragement that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline, nor faint when reproved by Him.
verses.display_text: and you have forgotten the encouragement that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline, nor faint when reproved by Him.

verses.text: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and scourges every son He receives.”
verses.display_text: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and scourges every son He receives.”

verses.text: Endure for discipline. God deals with you as sons; for what son is there whom a father does not discipline?
verses.display_text: Endure for discipline. God deals with you as sons; for what son is there whom a father does not discipline?

verses.text: But if you are without discipline, in which all have become partakers, then you are illegitimate children and not sons.
verses.display_text: But if you are without discipline, in which all have become partakers, then you are illegitimate children and not sons.

verses.text: Furthermore, we had our fathers in the flesh to discipline us, and we respected them. But shall we not much more submit to the Father of spirits and live?
verses.display_text: Furthermore, we had our fathers in the flesh to discipline us, and we respected them. But shall we not much more submit to the Father of spirits and live?

verses.text: For they disciplined us for a few days according to what seemed right to them, but He for our benefit, so that we may share in His holiness.
verses.display_text: For they disciplined us for a few days according to what seemed right to them, but He for our benefit, so that we may share in His holiness.

verses.text: Now every discipline seems for the present to be a matter of sorrow, not joy, but afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those trained through it.
verses.display_text: Now every discipline seems for the present to be a matter of sorrow, not joy, but afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those trained through it.

verses.text: Therefore straighten the drooping hands and the weakened knees,
verses.display_text: Therefore straighten the drooping hands and the weakened knees,

verses.text: and make straight tracks for your feet, so that what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather healed.
verses.display_text: and make straight tracks for your feet, so that what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather healed.

verses.text: Pursue peace with everyone, and sanctification, without which no one will see the Lord.
verses.display_text: Pursue peace with everyone, and sanctification, without which no one will see the Lord.

verses.text: Watch lest anyone fall short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness grow up and cause trouble, and through it many be defiled,
verses.display_text: Watch lest anyone fall short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness grow up and cause trouble, and through it many be defiled,

verses.text: lest anyone be sexually immoral or profane like Esau, who sold his own birthright for a single meal.
verses.display_text: lest anyone be sexually immoral or profane like Esau, who sold his own birthright for a single meal.

verses.text: For you know that even afterward, when he desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for repentance, although he sought it with tears.
verses.display_text: For you know that even afterward, when he desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for repentance, although he sought it with tears.

verses.text: For you have not approached what can be touched, and a blazing fire, and gloom and darkness and storm,
verses.display_text: For you have not approached what can be touched, and a blazing fire, and gloom and darkness and storm,

verses.text: and the sound of a trumpet and a voice speaking words, whose hearers begged that no further word be spoken to them.
verses.display_text: and the sound of a trumpet and a voice speaking words, whose hearers begged that no further word be spoken to them.

verses.text: For they could not bear the command: “Even if an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned.”
verses.display_text: For they could not bear the command: “Even if an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned.”

verses.text: And so fearful was the sight that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
verses.display_text: And so fearful was the sight that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”

verses.text: But you have approached Mount Zion and the city of the living God, heavenly Jerusalem, and myriads of angels in festive gathering,
verses.display_text: But you have approached Mount Zion and the city of the living God, heavenly Jerusalem, and myriads of angels in festive gathering,

verses.text: and the assembly of firstborn ones enrolled in the heavens, and God the judge of all, and the spirits of righteous ones who have been perfected,
verses.display_text: and the assembly of firstborn ones enrolled in the heavens, and God the judge of all, and the spirits of righteous ones who have been perfected,

verses.text: and Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and sprinkled blood that speaks better than Abel.
verses.display_text: and Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and sprinkled blood that speaks better than Abel.

verses.text: See that you do not refuse the One who speaks. For if those who refused the One instructing them on earth did not escape, much less shall we, if we turn away from the One from the heavens.
verses.display_text: See that you do not refuse the One who speaks. For if those who refused the One instructing them on earth did not escape, much less shall we, if we turn away from the One from the heavens.

verses.text: His voice shook the earth then, but now He has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heaven.”
verses.display_text: His voice shook the earth then, but now He has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heaven.”

verses.text: Now “yet once more” indicates the removal of the things shaken, as things that have been made, so that the things not shaken may remain.
verses.display_text: Now “yet once more” indicates the removal of the things shaken, as things that have been made, so that the things not shaken may remain.

verses.text: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be grateful, and through this gratitude serve God acceptably with reverence and awe,
verses.display_text: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be grateful, and through this gratitude serve God acceptably with reverence and awe,

verses.text: for indeed our God is a consuming fire.
verses.display_text: for indeed our God is a consuming fire.

verses.text: Let brotherly love remain.
verses.display_text: Let brotherly love remain.

verses.text: Do not forget hospitality, for through it some unknowingly entertained angels.
verses.display_text: Do not forget hospitality, for through it some unknowingly entertained angels.

verses.text: Remember the prisoners as fellow prisoners, and those being mistreated, as you yourselves also are in a body.
verses.display_text: Remember the prisoners as fellow prisoners, and those being mistreated, as you yourselves also are in a body.

verses.text: Let marriage be honored among all, and the marriage bed undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
verses.display_text: Let marriage be honored among all, and the marriage bed undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

verses.text: Let your way of life be free from the love of money, being content with what you have; for He Himself has said, “I will certainly not leave you, nor will I ever forsake you.”
verses.display_text: Let your way of life be free from the love of money, being content with what you have; for He Himself has said, “I will certainly not leave you, nor will I ever forsake you.”

verses.text: So we may say with confidence, “The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear. What will a person do to me?”
verses.display_text: So we may say with confidence, “The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear. What will a person do to me?”

verses.text: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. As you consider the outcome of their way of life, imitate their faith.
verses.display_text: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. As you consider the outcome of their way of life, imitate their faith.

verses.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and for the ages.
verses.display_text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and for the ages.

verses.text: Do not be carried away by varied and strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace, not by foods, which have not benefited those occupied with them.
verses.display_text: Do not be carried away by varied and strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace, not by foods, which have not benefited those occupied with them.

verses.text: We have an altar from which those serving the tent have no right to eat.
verses.display_text: We have an altar from which those serving the tent have no right to eat.

verses.text: For the bodies of those animals whose blood the high priest brings into the holy places for sin are burned outside the camp.
verses.display_text: For the bodies of those animals whose blood the high priest brings into the holy places for sin are burned outside the camp.

verses.text: Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the gate, so that He might sanctify the people through His own blood.
verses.display_text: Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the gate, so that He might sanctify the people through His own blood.

verses.text: So let us go out to Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach.
verses.display_text: So let us go out to Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach.

verses.text: For here we have no lasting city, but we seek the one to come.
verses.display_text: For here we have no lasting city, but we seek the one to come.

verses.text: Therefore through Him let us continually offer God a sacrifice of praise, that is, the fruit of lips confessing His name.
verses.display_text: Therefore through Him let us continually offer God a sacrifice of praise, that is, the fruit of lips confessing His name.

verses.text: And do not forget to do good and to share, for God is pleased with such sacrifices.
verses.display_text: And do not forget to do good and to share, for God is pleased with such sacrifices.

verses.text: Obey your leaders and yield to them, for they keep watch over your souls as those who will give an account, so that they may do this with joy and not groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
verses.display_text: Obey your leaders and yield to them, for they keep watch over your souls as those who will give an account, so that they may do this with joy and not groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

verses.text: Pray for us, for we are convinced that we have a good conscience, wishing to conduct ourselves well in everything.
verses.display_text: Pray for us, for we are convinced that we have a good conscience, wishing to conduct ourselves well in everything.

verses.text: And I urge you all the more to do this, so that I may be restored to you sooner.
verses.display_text: And I urge you all the more to do this, so that I may be restored to you sooner.

verses.text: Now may the God of peace, who brought up from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep, our Lord Jesus, in the blood of an eternal covenant,
verses.display_text: Now may the God of peace, who brought up from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep, our Lord Jesus, in the blood of an eternal covenant,

verses.text: equip you with every good thing to do His will, working in us what is pleasing in His sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for the ages of ages. Amen.
verses.display_text: equip you with every good thing to do His will, working in us what is pleasing in His sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for the ages of ages. Amen.

verses.text: And I urge you, brothers, bear with the word of encouragement, for I have written to you briefly.
verses.display_text: And I urge you, brothers, bear with the word of encouragement, for I have written to you briefly.

verses.text: Know that our brother Timothy has been released; if he comes soon, I will see you with him.
verses.display_text: Know that our brother Timothy has been released; if he comes soon, I will see you with him.

verses.text: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you.
verses.display_text: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you.

verses.text: Grace be with you all.
verses.display_text: Grace be with you all.
